name: Berget
title: Quartermaster of the Northguard
examine: Runs the armory like a ledger with opinions. Sells the makings to civilians at a margin she calls the wall tax, and considers the wall cheap at the price.
lines: Issued steel is counted steel. Sold steel is counted twice.
The wall tax is not a joke. It is a margin with a purpose, which is more than most jokes have.
Requisitions close at dusk. Emergencies may apply at any hour and had better be one.
